lesson_ratings.title: First Verse: Picture Perfect Blue
lesson_ratings.reason: Introduces rich vocabulary and metaphors about love and imagery.

lesson_ratings.title: Chorus: Boom Clap
lesson_ratings.reason: Teaches some useful phrases but relies heavily on repetition and onomatopoeia.

lesson_ratings.title: Second Verse: No Silver or No Gold
lesson_ratings.reason: Contains meaningful vocabulary and expressions about value and devotion.

lesson_ratings.title: Chorus: Boom Clap (Reprise)
lesson_ratings.reason: Exact reprise of the earlier chorus; no new learning content.

lesson_ratings.title: Bridge: You Are the Light
lesson_ratings.reason: Introduces new imagery and vocabulary about light and guidance.

lesson_ratings.title: Final Chorus (Part 1)
lesson_ratings.reason: Repetition of the chorus; no new material to learn.

lesson_ratings.title: Final Chorus (Part 2)
lesson_ratings.reason: Another repetition of the chorus; adds no new vocabulary.
